title: Split large predecessor reads into bounded source slices
failure_signature: A combined status and multi-slice predecessor source read exceeded its command budget after returning incomplete output.
candidate_workaround: Read one bounded source slice per command with a sufficient timeout and accept it only on a zero exit status.
recurrence_guard: Keep large source inspections independently bounded and never credit a timed-out aggregate as complete.
rollback: Discard the incomplete inspection result; the failed operation was read-only.
protected_gates: No evidence credit for partial reads
scope_boundary: This method addresses local source-reading reliability only and proves no scientific, authority, production, security, accessibility, or reproduction claim.
